description: Generates a unique username by combining first name, last name, and birth year with a random suffix using a cryptographically secure random source. (cost: 1 credit)

birth_year.description: integer, required, user's birth year, year, no default

first_name.description: string, required, user's first name, no units, no default

last_name.description: string, required, user's last name, no units, no default

name: generate_username
